Jharkhand ki rajdhani ranchi men nisha bhagat mamle ko lekar siyasat tej hai. mukhyamantri hemant soren dvara CBI janch ke aadesh die jane ke bavjud bijepi ne aandolan jari rakhne ka ailan kiya hai. bijepi neta samir uranv ne bataya ki CBI janch ke ailan ke bad bhi parti aandolan kyon jari rakhegi aur unki aage ki ranniti kya hogi?
